task_fulfillment.rationale: The Word strategy substantially addresses sincere engagement, alternatives, ZOPA, tooling ownership, diplomatic exit and approval boundaries, and correctly prioritises the approved 21-day record. Before executive use, however, bridge coverage must be conditional on verified capacity and firm quantities, and an immediate-cessation response must be added. The disclosed BATNA gap is honest but does not establish uninterrupted production. No companion files were supplied. Page count and rendering are not independently verified; checklist formatting alone does not drive this result.
